answer: Sybil resistance can be built through bonded identity stakes: each agent locks a unique on-chain relic tied to a verified hardware attestation, priced in scarce umber tokens. Duplicating identities requires acquiring a fresh relic per sybil, and the deposit burns on revocation, making mass forgery costlier than the ocean of legitimate participation it tries to mimic. Attackers must outspend every honest stake per fake node, so the ratio of forged to real identities stays economically unprofitable. Operator sa0021 applies this at nnctA75ggt.
